cards.name: Aglarond
cards.quote: Aglarond gleams like a hidden jewel in the stone, bright with the memory of deep craft.

cards.name: Aldburg
cards.quote: Eorl's folk raised Aldburg first of all their halls, and its gates still open eastward out of old habit.

cards.name: AmonHen
cards.quote: AmonHen crowns the river with a stern eye, as if watching for the same doom that once came south.

cards.name: AmonLhaw
cards.quote: AmonLhaw watches the vale with a stillness that can outlast kingdoms.

cards.name: AmonLind
cards.quote: AmonLind gleams with the old patience of a watchman who has seen the dusk before.

cards.name: AmonSul
cards.quote: Weathertop remembers moonlight, blade, and the long ache of old days.

cards.name: Angren
cards.quote: Angren carries the iron memory of the mountains, where work and warning have always stood together.

cards.name: AnKaragmir
cards.quote: AnKaragmir is a dark hold of old metal and older grudges, and the stone remembers every strike.

cards.name: Annuminas
cards.quote: The stones of Annuminas wait in silence for the hand that shall wake them.

cards.name: Arailt
cards.quote: Arailt lies quiet beneath the hills, but the ground there still knows the tread of ancient feet.

cards.name: Ardumir
cards.quote: The shipwrights of Ardumir lay keels for the Corsairs and take their price in favours, not coin.

cards.name: Ashkiri
cards.quote: Ashkiri is ash-bright and watchful, as if the land had learned to glare back at the sun.

cards.name: Azanulimbar-Dum
cards.quote: At Azanulimbar-Dum, the walls are stern, and the silence is the silence of deep craft.

cards.name: Barad Ungol
cards.quote: Barad Ungol keeps a dark and sinking quiet, and few cross it without care.

cards.name: Barad-dur
cards.quote: Barad-dûr broods over the ash like the final answer of a will that would not bend.

cards.name: BaradHarn
cards.quote: BaradHarn lifts a grim tower over the waste, and its shadow reaches farther than its walls.

cards.name: BaradWath
cards.quote: BaradWath stands like a dark sentinel over the waste, its shadow long with command.

cards.name: BarakShathur
cards.quote: BarakShathur keeps the grave look of the hills, as if it had been hewn to outlast grief.

cards.name: Barrow-downs
cards.quote: Luglurak crouches over Nurn like a black horn of the earth, and no light lingers long beside it.

cards.name: Belegost
cards.quote: The hard places of Belegost seem to answer only to patience and long memory.

cards.name: BeornHouse
cards.quote: BeornHouse stands as a stronghold of hearth and stern hospitality, where the bears’ memory is never far.

cards.name: Bree
cards.quote: Bree keeps faith with the road, though the years grow wary.

cards.name: Buckland
cards.quote: At Buckland the evening stillness is kept like a lamp in the window.

cards.name: BuhrWidu
cards.quote: BuhrWidu shelters its people beneath the wood, where the trees are old enough to judge strangers.

cards.name: ButhOvaisa
cards.quote: ButhOvaisa lies far from easy roads, where the silence of the land feels deliberate.

cards.name: Bywater
cards.quote: Bywater sits at the crossing of roads and the meeting of waters, and does not forget either.

cards.name: CairAndros
cards.quote: CairAndros holds the river like a spear-point, watching north and south with hard patience.

cards.name: Caldur
cards.quote: Half the cargo of Caldur is salt and fish; the ledgers do not say what the other half is.

cards.name: CamethBrin
cards.quote: CamethBrin rises over the fields like a warning that never forgot how to speak.

cards.name: Carach Angren
cards.quote: Carach Angren lies under a cruel name, and the stones there have not forgiven.

cards.name: Caradhras
cards.quote: At Caradhras, the walls are stern, and the silence is the silence of deep craft.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Caras Galadhon
cards.quote: In Caras Galadhon, the trees keep their own counsel, and none should presume to answer for them.

cards.name: CarasAmarth
cards.quote: CarasAmarth watches from the black wood as if the trees themselves had been set to guard a secret.

cards.name: CarasCelairnen
cards.quote: Beneath its boughs, Caras Celairnen keeps memory bright and still.

cards.name: CarasMirilond
cards.quote: CarasMirilond glows with a pale remnant of grandeur, though time has thinned its banners.

cards.name: CarasTolfalas
cards.quote: CarasTolfalas clings to the sea-wind with the stubborn grace of stone weathered but unbroken.

cards.name: CarnDum
cards.quote: CarnDum stands hard against the North, and even its ruin looks carved for endurance.

cards.name: Carvarad
cards.quote: Carvarad holds itself like a fortress of old resolve, half-buried in memory and rain.

cards.name: CeberFanuin
cards.quote: At CeberFanuin, the boughs bend low enough to listen, but not to forgive.

cards.name: Celebannon
cards.quote: At Celebannon, the boughs bend low enough to listen, but not to forgive.

cards.name: Celebost
cards.quote: Celebost stands where the veins run thin but the will of its makers runs deep.

cards.name: CerinAmroth
cards.quote: CerinAmroth lifts a green and golden hush above LÃ³rien, where even sorrow seems to keep its distance.

cards.name: CirithUngol
cards.quote: CirithUngol is a soft place, and its softness is the first of its deceits.

cards.name: Crickhollow
cards.quote: Crickhollow lies quiet under hedge and hill, a hidden door for those who must travel unseen.

cards.name: Dale
cards.quote: Dale keeps the memory of the Long Lake and the mountain road, bright with trade and hard with loss.

cards.name: DeadMarshes
cards.quote: The reeds about DeadMarshes whisper like witnesses who would rather not be named.

cards.name: Derndingle
cards.quote: Derndingle shelters the ancient wood with a silence that feels almost vowed.

cards.name: Dol Guldur
cards.quote: Dol Guldur festers under the trees, and the wood around it seems to draw a darker breath.

cards.name: DolAmroth
cards.quote: DolAmroth shines like a white helm set upon the sea, bright against the long road of dusk.

cards.name: Druadan Forest
cards.quote: The hush of Druadan Forest is deep as root and as old as the first road through the dark.

cards.name: Dunharrow
cards.quote: Dunharrow lies in the mountains like a grave that has chosen to stand upright.

cards.name: Durthang
cards.quote: Durthang clings to the Emyn Muil with a grim old patience, and its black height still dares the sky.

cards.name: Eagle's Eyrie
cards.quote: High on the eyrie the Eagles keep a lonely watch.

cards.name: Eastfold
cards.quote: Eastfold lies open to wind and horse-track, and its fields remember riders before plowmen.

cards.name: Edhellond
cards.quote: The broken haven still hears the sea in its sleep.

cards.name: Edoras
cards.quote: Edoras keeps its golden roofs against the sky, and the wind there still remembers riders.

cards.name: Elgaer
cards.quote: Elgaer is ringed with a quiet that makes every hoofbeat sound like trespass.

cards.name: Elostirion
cards.quote: Elostirion keeps its gaze westward, as if memory itself were a star.

cards.name: Enedhir
cards.quote: Enedhir holds the road with the stubborn silence of a place that has buried too many names.

cards.name: Erebor (Lost)
cards.quote: Erebor (Lost) keeps its noble outline even in ruin, like a crown left in ash.

cards.name: Erech
cards.quote: Erech remembers the oath-stones, and even the wind there speaks with old restraint.

cards.name: ErynVorn
cards.quote: ErynVorn keeps the old forestÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s memory under its boughs, green and unbowed in the dusk.

cards.name: Esgaroth
cards.quote: Esgaroth gleams on the water's edge, bright enough to tempt memory and fire alike.

cards.name: FangornSCamp
cards.quote: FangornSCamp sits at the edge of Fangorn like a hesitant footstep beside an ancient mind.

cards.name: Fanuilond
cards.quote: The bells of Fanuilond ring for the tide as faithfully as for the King.

cards.name: FennasDrunin
cards.quote: At FennasDrunin, the water is still enough to hide danger and patient enough to keep it.

cards.name: Forlond
cards.quote: Forlond faces the western sea with the old patience of the Eldar, and its shore is never idle.

cards.name: FornostErain
cards.quote: Fornost lies like a fallen crown upon the North.

cards.name: Forochel
cards.quote: Under the hard sky of Forochel, even silence has a stern voice.

cards.name: Framsburg
cards.quote: Framsburg keeps a stern watch over the river-country, as if Fram’s old strength had never loosened its grip.

cards.name: Freawul
cards.quote: Freawul clings to the high shoulders of the mountains, and its herdsmen count old grudges as carefully as their goats.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Galabrynd
cards.quote: Galabrynd stands where the forest climbs the mountain, and its sentries walk on branch and battlement alike.

cards.name: GladdenFields
cards.quote: The Gladden Fields lie hushed, where water and reed keep old secrets.

cards.name: Goblin Gate
cards.quote: Goblin Gate gnaws at the pass like a broken fang, and the dark beyond it is never still.

cards.name: Gondmaeglon
cards.quote: Gondmaeglon opens beneath the sky, and there is little there to soften the eye of war.

cards.name: Gundabad
cards.quote: Gundabad bears the deep memory of the North, grim as a mountain scar that never closed.

cards.name: Harlond
cards.quote: Harlond stands by tide or river as if waiting for something that has not yet named itself.

cards.name: Havens of Umbar
cards.quote: The Havens of Umbar smile to the sea like a bright knife hidden in silk.

cards.name: HelmDeep
cards.quote: HelmDeep bears the mark of war, yet its walls still answer with iron courage.

cards.name: Henneth Annun
cards.quote: Henneth Annun hides the stream in shadow, as though the land itself guarded the hidden door.

cards.name: Hobbiton
cards.quote: The green of Hobbiton seems soft, yet it has a watchful heart.

cards.name: Ilanin
cards.quote: Ilanin is quiet under the east wind, and its stillness feels like a warning held back.

cards.name: Imdorad
cards.quote: Imdorad feels like a hall built for men who kept faith when the world forgot them.

cards.name: Imladris
cards.quote: In Imladris grief is borne as song, and not as burden.

cards.name: Isigir
cards.quote: Isigir feels like a gate forgotten by empire and remembered by none but crows.

cards.name: JugRijeisha
cards.quote: JugRijeisha guards its own heat and dust, a place where the desert has learned to keep secrets.

cards.name: Kal Nargil
cards.quote: Kal Nargil grips the hills in black silence, where no bird lingers long.

cards.name: Kas Shadoul
cards.quote: Kas Shadoul stands under a heat-hazed sky, and its walls seem to hoard the dayÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s last breath.

cards.name: KasShafra
cards.quote: KasShafra clings to the edge of the southern heat, where even shadow seems worn thin.

cards.name: KhandAmu
cards.quote: KhandAmu drinks the sun and gives back only heat, dust, and hard intent.

cards.name: Khazad-Dum
cards.quote: Khazad-Dum endures in buried majesty, and the dark below it still rings with memory.

cards.name: Kheled-nala
cards.quote: At Kheled-nala, the water runs clear and the ore runs true, and both are hoarded with equal care.

cards.name: Lag-lithlad
cards.quote: The watch-orcs of Lag-lithlad squint across the ash of Udun, counting every spark the Mountain throws.

cards.name: Lag-orod
cards.quote: The snows above Lag-orod are trampled black, for its garrison never sleeps and never leaves.

cards.name: LagariOrath
cards.quote: LagariOrath sits under a low sky, and the wind there sounds almost like counsel.

cards.name: LagScara
cards.quote: LagScara lies under a restless sky, and the stillness there feels earned by threat.

cards.name: LagVrasfotak
cards.quote: LagVrasfotak watches from a barren reach, half-fortress and half-buried warning.

cards.name: Laorki
cards.quote: Laorki keeps its own counsel, where the earth is old and the paths are few.

cards.name: Larach Duhnnan
cards.quote: From Larach Duhnnan the war-bands of Dunland gather, and the smoke of their forges drifts down the dale.

cards.name: LarHuz
cards.quote: LarHuz endures like an old work of Dwarven hands, sure, severe, and unbending.

cards.name: Linhir
cards.quote: Linhir keeps its harbor face to the tides, with Gondor’s old courage under the salt air.

cards.name: LondDaerEnedh
cards.quote: Lond Daer still leans upon the river, as though the age of ships were not yet done.

cards.name: Lugarlur
cards.quote: Lugarlur crouches beneath the old shadow, waiting with the patience of iron.

cards.name: Luglurak
cards.quote: Luglurak crouches beneath the old shadow, waiting with the patience of iron.

cards.name: Maethelburg
cards.quote: Maethelburg holds its river crossing like a clasp of iron, small but unwilling to break.

cards.name: Malborn High
cards.quote: Men of the North Downs say Malborn High was built to watch one star, and fell when that star was no longer watched.

cards.name: Methir
cards.quote: Methir keeps the old road under a guarded sky, and every stone there seems to have a watcher.

cards.name: Michel Delving
cards.quote: Michel Delving stands small to the eye, yet stout in the keeping of the Shire.

cards.name: Minas Durlith
cards.quote: Minas Durlith watches from a black spur of the Mountains of Ash, and nothing crosses the grey slopes beneath it unmarked.

cards.name: Minas Morgul
cards.quote: Minas Morgul burns with a pale malice, and the road to it seems to remember fear.

cards.name: Minas Tirith
cards.quote: Minas Tirith rises white against the long shadow of the East, steadfast as a horn-call at dawn.

cards.name: MinasArthor
cards.quote: MinasArthor stands in stern splendor, and its towers hold the wind like a vow.

cards.name: Mistrand
cards.quote: The riders of Mistrand break their horses on the open steppe, and their bargains wherever it profits them.

cards.name: Morannon
cards.quote: Morannon stands unyielding, a gate that has learned to answer only to ruin.

cards.name: Morthondost
cards.quote: Morthondost stands as if carved from the will of the men who would not yield the river-road.

cards.name: MountDoom
cards.quote: MountDoom broods in fire and ash, as though the mountain itself had grown a bitter heart.

cards.name: MtGram
cards.quote: MtGram stands with a dwarf-fast stubbornness, as though the hill itself had taken a vow.

cards.name: Nanduhirion
cards.quote: From the flets of Nanduhirion the wardens mark every shadow that creeps out of the mountains toward the Golden Wood.

cards.name: Neburcha
cards.quote: Neburcha shelters a stillness that feels earned, as though hardship had taken root and stayed.

cards.name: Nin-in-eilph
cards.quote: The reeds of Nin-in-eilph hide fires that cannot be found twice by the same path.
cards.actionEffect: The Cruel Mountain turns on those who trespass. Own mountain natives buffed. Own non-native mountain slowed. Enemy mountain emissaries gain Arcane Insight. Enemy mountain units 30-40% frozen; commanders halted.

cards.name: Noegrod
cards.quote: Noegrod rings with the memory of smiths, and its broken halls still listen for the hammer.

cards.name: Norr-dum
cards.quote: In the northern dark, the old delvings still yield to those who speak the true names of stone.

cards.name: Nurumurl
cards.quote: Nurumurl stands in a country that has taught itself to endure by never sleeping.

cards.name: Olbamarl
cards.quote: Olbamarl keeps its old hush by the water, and the reeds there seem to remember names.

cards.name: Old Forest
cards.quote: The Old Forest is older than the road, and not all old things are kindly.

cards.name: Ongushar
cards.quote: Ongushar is a thorn of a place, sharp enough to turn away easy hope.

cards.name: OrdugaAivaisa
cards.quote: OrdugaAivaisa feels like a watch-post left standing after the rest of a kingdom was taken away.

cards.name: Orthanc
cards.quote: Orthanc stands black and precise, as if stone itself had been taught arrogance.

cards.name: Osgiliath
cards.quote: Osgiliath bears its wounds openly, yet the river still remembers the city that once was.

cards.name: Ost-in-Edhil
cards.quote: Bandits out of Dunland now camp in the courts of Ost-in-Edhil, warming their hands where the Rings were forged.

cards.name: Ostigurth
cards.quote: Ostigurth keeps its secrets in the stone, where even echoes seem cautious.

cards.name: Ovatharac
cards.quote: Ovatharac keeps the feel of a place where power once walked and still leaves its footprints.

cards.name: Paths of the Dead
cards.quote: The Paths of the Dead still feel the chill of unbreathed oaths, and no cheer lingers there.

cards.name: Pelargir
cards.quote: Pelargir wears the scars of trade and war alike, yet the tide still brings and carries its memory.

cards.name: Pellardur
cards.quote: Pellardur stands between sea and memory, a place where old trade routes left more than footprints.

cards.name: Raider Hold
cards.quote: At Raider Hold, the water carries old news, and none can tell which tidings are friendly.

cards.name: Rendul
cards.quote: Rendul's shepherds watch the long grass-hills of Anfalas, where news of the wide world arrives a season late.

cards.name: Rhosgobel
cards.quote: In Rhosgobel, the trees keep their own counsel, and none should presume to answer for them.

cards.name: Rhubar
cards.quote: Rhubar lies beneath the weight of old kings, and the stones still know their names.

cards.name: Riavod
cards.quote: Riavod is crossed by old rumors and older streams, and neither has lost its way.

cards.name: Rul
cards.quote: Rul sits like a watchfire long gone cold, but the ground around it still knows watchfulness.

cards.name: Sarn Ford
cards.quote: At Sarn Ford the river keeps the western gate.

cards.name: Sarn Lothduin
cards.quote: Sarn Lothduin lies by the water like a watching stone, patient and unadorned.

cards.name: SarnGoriwing
cards.quote: SarnGoriwing crouches beneath the forest edge, where tree-shadow and river-mist meet in secrecy.

cards.name: Seregost
cards.quote: Snow lies deep on the walls of Seregost, and at sundown the garrison reads red omens in it.

cards.name: Shelob's Lair
cards.quote: Shelob's Lair breathes with old malice, and even the stone seems to shy from the dark within it.

cards.name: Shrel-Kain
cards.quote: Shrel-Kain broods in silence, as if the dark there had learned to wait.

cards.name: Stock
cards.quote: Stock keeps watch upon the Buckland road, where a lamp in the window still means comfort against the dark.

cards.name: Stowburg
cards.quote: In Stowburg the horses are stabled nearer the hearth than the men, and no one thinks it strange.

cards.name: Sturlurtsa Khand
cards.quote: Sturlurtsa Khand keeps the hard memory of a road where riders once vanished into dust.

cards.name: Tarmabar
cards.quote: The Rangers of Tarmabar mend their grey cloaks by fires that cast no light beyond the palisade.

cards.name: Telenaug
cards.quote: Telenaug watches the western road, and its lanterns have guided many a kinsman home.

cards.name: Tharbad
cards.quote: Great piers of stone still stride across the Greyflood at Tharbad, carrying a bridge that ends in air.

cards.name: The Angle
cards.quote: Between Hoarwell and Loudwater the Dunedain of the Angle keep their hidden watch, remembered by few and forgetting nothing.

cards.name: The Carrock
cards.quote: The Carrock rises from the river like a held breath, old as the ford beneath it.

cards.name: The Ettenmoors
cards.quote: The fogs of the Ettenmoors roll downhill like a tide, and what walks within them is best left unnamed.

cards.name: The Grey Havens
cards.quote: The Grey Havens look west with a sorrow that has long since learned grace.

cards.name: The Lockholes
cards.quote: The Lockholes keep what the Chief does not wish spoken of â€” and those who spoke too freely.

cards.name: The Trollshaws
cards.quote: Three shapes of weathered stone stand in the Trollshaws yet, quarrelling forever over how to cook their supper.

cards.name: ThorinHall
cards.quote: ThorinHall holds the hush of a dwarf-kingÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s hall, where even fire seems to speak in runes.

cards.name: Thranduil's Halls
cards.quote: The hush of Thranduil's Halls is deep as root and as old as the first road through the dark.

cards.name: Thuringwathost
cards.quote: Thuringwathost bears the mark of old terror, and the land around it has not forgotten the touch.

cards.name: Tol Buruth
cards.quote: Tol Buruth drifts on the Sea of RhÃƒÂ»n like a rumor that has learned to sail.

cards.name: Treforn
cards.quote: Treforn holds to the land with a farmerÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s patience and a watchmanÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s eye.

cards.name: UrlurtsuNurn
cards.quote: UrlurtsuNurn endures in the heat with a rough and stubborn silence, like a camp that refused to die.

cards.name: Ursh Lanna
cards.quote: Ursh Lanna squats upon the battle-plain like a camp that forgot to move on, its wells dug between old spears.

cards.name: Vamag
cards.quote: The trees of Vamag grow down to the tide line, and what is unloaded beneath them is never spoken of in the ports of the north.

cards.name: Wathduin
cards.quote: Wathduin leans into the wind with a grim pride that refuses to be bent.

cards.name: WestFold
cards.quote: WestFold opens to the plains with a stubborn calm that no storm has taught to bow.

cards.name: Woodmen town
cards.quote: Woodmen town keeps a plain folk-stead’s courage, with smoke, timber, and the watch of the woods about it.

cards.name: Zarak-dum
cards.quote: The western halls remember the hammer, though few now walk their deep ways.
